title: Simple factory separates creation
purpose: Show composition-based SimplePizzaFactory with product hierarchy and common preparation workflow.
alt: PizzaStore가 SimplePizzaFactory에 생성을 위임하고 Pizza 공통 인터페이스로 조리하는 구조
requiredChecks: PizzaStore uses a SimplePizzaFactory object; orderPizza(type) calls factory.createPizza(type).
Factory returns abstract Pizza; concrete examples extend Pizza.
Pizza defines prepare(), bake(), cut(), box(), called in that order by store.
Simple Factory is identified as a creation helper, distinct from subclass-based Factory Method.
prompt: Create a NEW ORIGINAL English raster technical diagram for a design-pattern reference blog. Opaque white background, large navy sans-serif typography, readable monospaced class/method names, restrained blue/teal panels, large gutters, no logos or copied slide. Title 'Simple factory separates creation'. TOP left PizzaStore 'factory: SimplePizzaFactory' 'orderPizza(type)' arrow 'delegates creation' to SimplePizzaFactory 'createPizza(type): Pizza'. Factory arrow 'returns Pizza' to abstract Pizza card 'prepare(); bake(); cut(); box()'. BELOW concrete products group lists CheesePizza, GreekPizza, VeggiePizza, PepperoniPizza, each explicitly 'extends Pizza'; caption 'Representative concrete products'. FOOTER workflow 'createPizza(type) → prepare() → bake() → cut() → box() → return Pizza'. Bottom note 'Simple Factory uses composition; it is not the subclass-based Factory Method pattern'. No PizzaStore extends SimplePizzaFactory arrow or same-direction inheritance confusion.
